capability: Build harmony from a few typed parts
title: Three parts, many songs.

hook.picture: Close on the whale hand-knotting a long sound line, knot after knot. Each knot is a one-off tweak that nobody wrote down.
hook.words: I'll just tweak it by hand.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Every new film means building the sound from scratch again.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three films, three tangled lines, each started from nothing and each tangled differently (every 2 beats, then 1, then half).
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each piece starts from a blank page.

stakes.body: Weeks go into sound that cannot be rebuilt, reused or checked.

solution_hint: Build from a few parts you can check.

metaphor.body: Three small typed cards and a short list of moves. Every new sound is a tree of cards snapped at joints that only take the right kind, with a receipt at each joint.

steps.picture: Three small cards drop onto the line, each with its own tab: pink, green, yellow.
steps.sound: Three tuned chimes, one per tab.

steps.picture: The whale applies moves (stretch, stack, filter). Each move snaps two cards together at a joint, and a tick lands on every joint.
steps.words: Few parts. Fixed moves. Endless pieces.

steps.picture: Push-in: a pink card is pushed into a joint shaped for green. It is refused with a rust ✕, a small shake and a drop.
steps.words: A wrong fit is refused. Typed atoms.
steps.sound: A muted thud on the refusal.

steps.picture: Receipts ripple up the joints to a finished line.

real_case.claim: Glyph Foundry's README lists Orpheum Studio Pro v4 as 3 primary atoms with 16 operations plus spectral filtering, verified by 24 adversarial gates (author-reported).

honest_limit.picture: A tree built only from right-fitting cards plays a piece that passes every joint, yet the listening pod is unmoved.
honest_limit.words: Every part fits. The piece is still dull.

ending_pattern.body: Asked again for last week's sound, the whale rebuilds it from the written list of cards and moves instead of the tangle, and the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close shot as bar 1, where last week's sound could not be rebuilt. Now it can.

end_belief.body: Make new work from parts you can check.

score_self.reason: Good pain for researchers and builders. The few-parts idea is clear. The case is a README quote of a private repo, so it is thin. 'Typed atoms' risks jargon density in MOVE.
